_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats - DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Planned Maintenance System (PMS) Quality Assurance Check Sheet
summary: The PMS Quality Assurance Check Sheet provides the minimum record-keeping requirements for the developing activity to administer a quality assurance program ensuring quality, technical accuracy, composition and graphic quality.
use_relationship:
The Planned Maintenance System (PMS) Quality Assurance (QA) Check Sheet provides the minimum record-keeping requirements for the developing activity to administer a quality assurance program, thereby ensuring the quality, technical accuracy, composition and graphic quality are consistent with applicable technical instructions.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, preparation instructions and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in Appendix C of MIL-STD-3034A.
This DID is related to DI-PSSS-80986B, Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) Maintenance Requirement Index (MRI); DI-PSSS-80991B, Planned Maintenance System (PMS) Maintenance Requirement Card (MRC); DI-PSSS-80992B, Planned Maintenance System (PMS) Maintenance Index Page (MIP).
This DID supersedes DI-MNTY-80993.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The PMS QA Check Sheet shall be in a format similar to that of the sample form of Figure 1 of this DID.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The PMS QA Check Sheet shall contain all of the information specified in the sample form of Figure 1 of this DID and as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, Appendix C.

children.title: System/Equipment.
children.content: Enter the nomenclature of the system, subsystem, equipment, as applicable.

children.title: MIP Series.
children.content: Enter the Maintenance Index Page (MIP) series identification.

children.title: MRC Number.
children.content: Enter the identification number of the applicable MRC.

children.title: Checked By Column.
children.content: Enter the initials of the personnel performing the quality assurance check for each item of documentation that was inspected in 4 below.

children.title: Date Column.
children.content: Enter the date each item of documentation which was inspected by the personnel performing the quality assurance check in 4 below.

preparation_instructions.title: Quality Assurance Checks.
preparation_instructions.content: The following quality assurance checks, as specified in the sample form of Figure 1 of this DID concern MIL-STD-3034A procedure areas:

children.title: Correct nomenclatures are in Ship system
children.content: Correct nomenclatures are in Ship system, system, subsystem and equipment area as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.6.

children.title: ESWBS levels are in Ship system
children.content: ESWBS levels are in Ship system, system, subsystem, and equipment area as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.6.

children.title: Correct MIP series
children.content: Correct MIP series is in MRC Code area as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.n.

children.title: Correct periodicity code
children.content: Correct periodicity code is in the MRC code area as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.n.

children.title: Rates area
children.content: Rates area is filled as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.o.

children.title: M/H area
children.content: M/H area is properly filled in as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.o.

children.title: Preliminary time
children.content: Preliminary time is included in M/H area as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.o.

children.title: Total M/H and Elapsed Time areas
children.content: Total M/H and Elapsed Time areas are correctly computed and filled in as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraphs 5.1.10.2.p and 5.1.10.2.q, respectively.

children.title: MR Description area
children.content: MR Description area is properly filled in (complete sentence, second person imperative, and beginning with an action verb) as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.l and C.8.

children.title: Safety Precautions area
children.content: Safety Precautions area is properly filled in (first precaution refers to a manual or instruction) as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.m.

children.title: All other specified warnings
children.content: All other specified warnings in Safety Precautions area are in the same order in which they appear in the procedure block as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.m.(1).

children.title: Cautions do not appear
children.content: Cautions do not appear in Safety Precautions area as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.3.11.b.

children.title: For submarine applications
children.content: For submarine applications, Safety Precautions area contains re-entry control statement as required as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.m.(4) and 5.1.10.2.r.(7).

children.title: Safety Precautions area contains cleaning solvent statement
children.content: Safety Precautions area contains cleaning solvent statement when required as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.m.(5).

children.title: Safety Precautions area contains the "DO NOT WORK ALONE" statement
children.content: Safety Precautions area contains the "DO NOT WORK ALONE" statement, and Rates/MH areas contain the suitable number of personnel, when required as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.m.(2), 5.1.10.2.o, and 5.1.10.2.p.

children.title: Tools, Parts, Materials, and Test Equipment area
children.content: Tools, Parts, Materials, and Test Equipment area is properly filled in in the following order: test equipment materials, parts, tools, and miscellaneous as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.r.

children.title: Sub-Category (SCAT) codes and nomenclature
children.content: Sub-Category (SCAT) codes and nomenclature for test equipment are listed as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.r.(12).(a).

children.title: Tools are listed by proper nomenclature
children.content: Tools are listed by proper nomenclature as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.r.(8).

children.title: Materials and lubricants are identified
children.content: Materials and lubricants are identified by government specification number, item name, and nomenclature as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.r.(13).(b).

children.title: Page number area
children.content: Page number area is properly filled in as specified MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.21.

children.title: Repair parts are properly listed
children.content: Repair parts are properly listed as specified MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.r.(12).(c).

children.title: Equipage and special materials
children.content: Equipage and special materials are properly listed as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.10.2.r.(12).(e).

children.title: Classification markings, if applicable
children.content: Classification markings, if applicable, are properly filled in as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.5.

children.title: Language, sentence structure, steps, and terminology
children.content: Language, sentence structure, steps, and terminology meet standard criteria as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraphs C.3.1 through C.3.10.

children.title: Notes are not used for action steps
children.content: Notes are not used for action steps as specified in the MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.10 and C.3.11.c.

children.title: Notes are numbered if MRC contains more than one
children.content: Notes are numbered if MRC contains more than one as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.10.

children.title: Warnings and cautions precede applicable step
children.content: Warnings and cautions precede applicable step in which hazard is encountered as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.3.11 and C.11.

children.title: Repeat steps are used properly
children.content: Repeat steps are used properly as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.12.a.

children.title: References to other publications
children.content: References to other publications are restricted as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.4.7.

children.title: Scheduled MRC references
children.content: Scheduled MRC references are properly made as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.4.8 and C.12.

children.title: Unscheduled MRC references
children.content: Unscheduled MRC references are properly made as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.7.3.

children.title: Fill-in blanks are used properly
children.content: Fill-in blanks are used properly as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.13.a.2.

children.title: All initial "make ready" steps
children.content: All initial "make ready" steps, such as energizing equipment warmup, positioning switches, opening door, and establishing communications, are included in Preliminary as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.14.

children.title: MR description is exactly as in MR Description area
children.content: MR description is exactly as in MR Description area with initial capitals and underlined, or in boldface as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.15.

children.title: Procedural steps directing removal of voltage, pressure, etc.
children.content: Procedural steps directing removal of voltage, pressure, etc. specify the system and equipment nomenclature and refer to the applicable tag-out procedures as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraphs 5.1.10.2.s.(8) and C.9.

children.title: All steps within each MR
children.content: All steps within each MR are in continuous alpha-numerical sequence as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.22.3.

children.title: Tables are numbered and referenced
children.content: Tables are numbered and referenced in text as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.17 and C.22.5.

children.title: Close-out statement is included
children.content: Close-out statement is included at completion of procedure, if applicable, as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.15.c.

children.title: Procedural steps are factual and concise
children.content: Procedural steps are factual and concise, and are not susceptible to misinterpretation as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraphs 5.1.10.2.s and C.3.1.

children.title: Optimum value is stated
children.content: Optimum value is stated, followed by a range, when a measure or adjustment is identified as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.3.1.

children.title: No words are misspelled
children.content: No words are misspelled as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.3.8.

children.title: Abbreviations used are approved
children.content: Abbreviations used are approved as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.3.9.

children.title: Signs and symbols are standard
children.content: Signs and symbols are standard as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.3.10.

children.title: Figures are numbered and referenced
children.content: Figures are numbered and referenced in text as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.22.4.

children.title: Spacing and format meet standard criteria
children.content: Spacing and format meet standard criteria as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.22.2.

children.title: Preferred words and expressions
children.content: Preferred words and expressions are used as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, Appendix E.

children.title: Capitalization meets standard criteria
children.content: Capitalization meets standard criteria as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.3.7 and Appendix E.

children.title: Line art meets standard criteria
children.content: Line art meets standard criteria as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph C.16.
